description: A 'significant' improvement with no test and one run must be challenged.

inputs.label: Results notes
inputs.content:
Results (one run each, no repeats):
Tuned LED spectrum: 128.4 g mean fresh biomass per plant
Fixed white-light control: 121.9 g mean fresh biomass per plant

Our spectrum significantly outperforms the control. The improvement is consistent
and statistically meaningful. We did not run significance tests.
